entries.text: 藍莓學園！\n好～厲害呀～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_first_01

entries.text: 藍莓學園和學院\n真的完全不一樣呢！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_00

entries.text: 我稍微參觀了一下生態巨蛋，\n真不敢相信那竟然是在海裡！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_01

entries.text: 學園的方針似乎也\n很重視寶可夢對戰，\r\n也就是說……可以對戰打到飽！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_02

entries.text: 太好了！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 要適可而止喔！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 嗯！事情辦完之後，\n我要去找遍這裡的人，和他們一個個對戰！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_03

entries.text: 對不起，我忘了！\n我還得和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰，\r\n所以得留下餘力對吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_03b

entries.text: 我去生態巨蛋逛了一下，\n裡面有好多我沒見過的寶可夢！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_00

entries.text: 在北上的時候也是這樣，\n看著自己不認識的寶可夢\r\n在大自然中生活，真的很有趣！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_01

entries.text: 這和在教科書上看的感覺\n完全不一樣！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_02

entries.text: 感覺很真實！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 感覺很新鮮！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 對對！就是那種感覺！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_03

entries.text: 然後我突然想起來，帕底亞的寶可夢\n在一開始的時候也讓我覺得很新鮮！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_04

entries.text: 我是在７歲的時候\n搬家到帕底亞的。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_05

entries.text: 那時我還沒有接觸寶可夢對戰。\n我都把那種感覺給忘了呢～[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_06

entries.text: 真是不能忘記初心呀！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_07

entries.text: 知道啊！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 妳在說什麼……？
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_select_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳果然知道！\n怎麼不立刻告訴我呀～！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_01

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想掩飾也沒用！\n我已經查得一清二楚了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_01b

entries.text: 而且大家還說\n藍莓聯盟的冠軍就是[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_02

entries.text: 其實就是這樣！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_select_03

entries.text: 妳在說什麼……？
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_select_04

entries.text: 看吧，我就知道！\n這種事[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳應該早點告訴我的～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳騙不過我的！\n要是有必要，我還有證人喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_03b

entries.text: 雖然我很想立刻就和\n藍莓聯盟的冠軍打一場，但是……[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_04

entries.text: 更重要的是，看到我的勁敵在各地\n大顯身手，我真的好高興喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_05

entries.text: 嗯～所以……\n以後也請多多指教喔！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_06

entries.text: ……不知怎麼，\n就突然變得正經起來了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_00

entries.text: 話說回來，\n我們雖然對戰了很多次，\r\n但從來沒有交換過寶可夢呢！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_01

entries.text: 要不要趁這個機會\n來交換一下寶可夢啊！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_02

entries.text: 太好了！我好高興！\n那我就用肯泰羅來交換吧！\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要選哪個孩子呢？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]！真讚！\n我會把牠培育到無人能擊敗牠的！\r\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳跟我交換！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_04

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_02_03

entries.text:
只有１隻寶可夢的話，
交換之後會有點危險呢！\c
我想還是在同行寶可夢有
２隻以上的時候再交換比較好！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_03_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有其他事要做嗎？\n那就下次再來交換吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_03_01

entries.text: 上次我們沒能交換寶可夢，\n現在快來交換吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_04_00

entries.text: 如果[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有時間的話，\n要不要來一場寶可夢對戰？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_talkto_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳正在調整同行隊伍嗎？\n嗯～……真遺憾！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_cancel_00

entries.text: 太好了！就這麼決定了！\n我們來打一場收穫多多的對戰吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 這次是我輸了！\n啊～打得真開心！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 真希望長大之後我也能一直！\n一～直和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰下去。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 如果能那樣就好了，\n我們一定要去實現它喔！\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳收下這個當作我們約定的證明吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 使用時就當作是我在幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳吧！\n以後也……請多多指教喔！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_reward_00

entries.text: 這次是我輸了！\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳和我對戰！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 下次我一定不會輸的！\n要再跟我對戰喔！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: 耶～！\n這次是我贏了！\r\n但是，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也打得漂亮喔！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
藍莓學園上課的時候
似乎不太會使用教室呢！\c
竟然是在巨蛋裡上課，
簡直是文化衝擊啊！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_00

entries.text: 雖然發生了很多事，\n但在北上鄉的日子真的很開心！\r\n好想再和大家一起去旅行喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
聽說藍莓學園
也有四天王！\c
他們都是用些什麼樣的寶可夢呢！？
嗯～好想知道啊！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]是越來越茁壯成熟了喔！\n讓我們交換的寶可夢互相對戰，\r\n感覺會很有趣呢！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我交換給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的肯泰羅
在之前的尋寶中幫了我很多忙喔！\c
如果[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能好好培育牠，
對我來說就是最開心的事了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_04
